import socket,struct
def dns(name,server='8.8.8.8'):
    q=struct.pack('>HHHHHH',1,1,0,0,0,0)
    for p in name.split('.'): q+=bytes([len(p)])+p.encode()+b'\x00'
    q+=struct.pack('>HH',1,1)
    s=socket.socket(socket.AF_INET,socket.SOCK_DGRAM); s.settimeout(8)
    s.sendto(q,(server,53)); data,_=s.recvfrom(512)
    an=struct.unpack('>H',data[6:8])[0]
    print(name,'->',an,'answers')
    off=12
    for _ in range(an):
        off+=2
        while data[off]: off+=data[off]+1; off+=1
        t,cl,tl=struct.unpack('>HHH',data[off:off+10]); off+=10
        if t==1 and tl==4: print('  A', '.'.join(map(str,data[off:off+4])))
        off+=tl
for n in ['github.com','codeload.github.com','raw.githubusercontent.com']:
    try: dns(n)
    except Exception as e: print(n,'ERR',e)
" 2>&1
